kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Binder M8 and M12-A moulded cable assemblies.
intro.zh: Binder M8 与 M12-A 模制电缆组件。

intro.en: Binder circular connector components from manufacturer order tables.
intro.zh: 原厂订货表列明的 Binder 圆形连接材料。

checks_title.en: Six Decisions Behind the Part Number
checks_title.zh: 型号背后的六个选型要点

copy.en: Confirm the Binder series, coding, contact sex and mating number.
copy.zh: 确认 Binder 系列、编码、触点公母与对插件编号。

copy.en: Distinguish moulded cordsets, field-wireable connectors and panel components.
copy.zh: 区分模制预制线、现场装配接头与面板端材料。

copy.en: Set conductor size, pin map, shielding and length for the circuit.
copy.zh: 按回路确定线径、针脚对应、屏蔽与长度。

copy.en: Check panel thickness, thread, exit direction and installation clearance.
copy.zh: 核对面板厚度、螺纹、出线方向与安装空间。

copy.en: Review the actual mating assembly, cable diameter and seal compression.
copy.zh: 核对实际对插组合、线缆外径与密封压缩量。

copy.en: Keep the selected parts, assembly instructions and test requirements on one controlled specification.
copy.zh: 将选定零件、装配说明与测试要求纳入同一份受控规格。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。

service_label.zh: 可制作兼容替代件、自有原厂采购渠道
